counterfactual_missing_items: No calcifications, cystic components, or multiple mature tissue types are described to support teratoma.
No purely homogeneous fat without enhancing soft-tissue nodular/linear areas is described to support simple lipoma.
No normal right adrenal gland separate from the mass is described, making extra-adrenal lipoma less plausible.
decisive_items: a large right retroperitoneal predominantly fatty mass in the location of the right adrenal gland
a well-defined, encapsulated retroperitoneal lesion of mostly fat density with internal areas of soft-tissue density in the hepatorenal space
the right adrenal gland was not visualized separately
response.rationale: R1 best integrates CT and MRI: a fat-predominant, well-encapsulated retroperitoneal mass located at the right adrenal gland with soft-tissue elements and no invasion. R4 is the closest alternative because it accounts for a mixed fat/soft-tissue mass, but it lacks adrenal-specific evidence and required teratomatous features. R3 ignores the soft-tissue/enhancing components and adrenal origin. C1 is an append-only restatement of R1 using the same raw span and offers no independent evidence.

rejected.why: Correlated restatement of R1; same raw support span and no additional raw evidence beyond appending 'retroperitoneal'.
Simple lipoma is contradicted by CT/MRI internal soft-tissue density and enhancing nodular/linear areas, and by adrenal location.
